constraints: input array a must be provided

axis.description: optional integer specifying the axis along which to find the minimum value. If ``axis`` is not specified, ``a`` will be flattened.
constraints: axis must satisfy -rank(input) <= axis < rank(input) if specified

keepdims.description: if True, then return an array with the same number of dimensions as ``a``.

output.description: an array containing the index of the minimum value along the specified axis.
